verdict.rationale: Radar's own Risk insights feature shows the risk factors behind its scoring, plus a network of related payments sharing customer ID, IP, or card. That directly addresses explainability. The evidence is thin, though: it does not show that every scored transaction gets ranked top factors, or that these explanations are available beyond the Dashboard view. Missing for 10: confirmation that factors accompany every score, ranked top-factor detail, API/programmatic exposure of factors, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a risk analyst, every score comes with its top risk factors — why this transaction looks risky — not just an opaque number

citations.quote: Risk insights shows you the risk factors that power Stripe Radar.
You can also view the network of related payments, which includes any other payments made to your business using the same customer ID, IP address, or card number
